intended_use.value: Used internally by customer support teams to review ticket content, identify priorities, and prepare responses. The agent receives ticket content from support staff and returns summaries for their review.

limitations.value: The agent only summarizes information provided to it; it cannot access historical ticket data, customer profiles, or external knowledge bases unless that context is explicitly included in the input.

out_of_scope_uses.value: Direct customer communication, automated ticket responses, ticket routing decisions, access to live ticketing systems.

purpose.value: Helps support teams quickly understand customer issues by generating concise, structured summaries of support tickets.
